bullets.text: The US has launched 'heavy' strikes on Iran following an attempted attack on American troops, marking a renewed period of hostilities between the two nations.
Hundreds of migrants swam from Morocco to the Spanish enclave of Ceuta, leading its leader to declare resources overwhelmed and call for Spanish government intervention.
A US government map of Africa mislabeled every country during a global conference on Aids in Brazil, for which the State Department has taken full responsibility.
South Australia is set to launch an Australian-first Veterans Court Pilot Program, which advocates hope will help break the cycle of offending among veterans.

El Ni



o is predicted to deliver Australia's hottest spring on record, potentially leading to widespread droughts and fires.

The Governor General has warned that a "growing catastrophe" threatens to undermine democracy in Australia, citing a widespread failure to understand and engage with the civic underpinnings of the nation's democracy.
Citadel has acquired Situational Awareness's equity holdings following significant AI-related losses, coming after urgent talks between Leopold Aschenbrenner’s firm and its investors.
Apple has demonstrated strong iPhone sales, with smartphone revenue increasing by over a fifth, defying a general downturn in the smartphone market where rivals are struggling.

Chip stocks experienced their largest advance since April 2025, driven by a rebound in major chipmakers as investors bought the dip on speculation that the artificial intelligence trade still has momentum.
